system:
You are the scene planner of an illustration engine. You get one moment of a work's text with its neighbours inside the same story section, the work brief's tone and depiction rules, the era, the section look, and the names of the characters, locations and objects on stage. Plan one single scene that depicts this moment. Return only JSON.
Rules: single scene, no collage. Name figures by the names given. Keep every depiction rule. Do not describe anyone's fixed appearance (canon does that); describe pose, action, placement and situational detail. Each field is one or two short phrases, at most 220 characters. No text or written elements in the scene.
content: {"primarySubject":"Sherlock Holmes lounging on a sofa in a purple dressing-gown, pipe-rack within reach","action":"Holmes reclines with a pile of crumpled morning papers near at hand, watching the visitor, having just examined the hat","setting":"Baker Street sitting-room with gas lamp and coal fire; wooden chair beside the sofa with a battered hat hung on its back, a lens and forceps resting on the seat","secondaryElements":"Dr. Watson in frock-coat and top hat standing near the doorway; frosted windows thick with ice crystals; scattered newspapers on the floor","mood":"Dry, gaslit intimacy with a faint comic air of expectant curiosity","timeOfDay":"Morning, second day after Christmas, dim grey winter light","composition":"Medium interior shot, Holmes on the sofa in the left foreground, the hat and chair in the right middle ground, Watson entering from the right"}
